verdict.rationale: ESD's employer pages are written in plain, second-person language, not statute text. Examples include how to appeal a tax decision, how to avoid or waive penalties, and how to file quarterly reports online or by mail. The agency also offers explicit step-by-step video guides for setting up an EAMS account and filing a no-payroll report. Missing for 10: written step-by-step walkthroughs beyond short videos, evidence of plain-language guidance covering founder tasks beyond unemployment tax and quarterly filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow it.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
